title: Kohler refuses to name his sources

tellings.quote: The information it was told to me as a story. However, the names where I got it from was entrusted to me as a confidency

plain: In 1950, at the radio station KMYR in Denver, Colorado, a man named George Kohler refused to say who had given him a story he was spreading. In his own recorded words, played on the episode, the information "was told to me as a story," but the names of the people he got it from were entrusted to him in confidence. His silence is why the source of his story could never be checked.
